newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end lower as market awaits word from Fed.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end lower as market awaits word from Fed.

text.p: UK shares extended Monday's steep decline on Tuesday as concerns about higher U.S. interest rates sparked another wave of profit-taking, traders said.
The FTSE 100 index of leading shares closed 9.2 points lower at 3,910.5, as decliners outnumbered advancers by a margin of about five to four.
Volume was thin, with only 545.8 million shares recorded at 1533 GMT.
Traders said the market was on hold ahead of today's FOMC meeting, where U.S. policymakers are expected to raise rates by between one quarter and one half of a percentage point.
